newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT manager quits on KPN takeover.
newsitem.headline: TNT manager quits on KPN takeover.

text.p: Leading TNT managers are to leave the global express company in Germany following its takeover by the Dutch post company KPN.
One of these managers will be Frank Blochmann, president of the TNT group for central and eastern Europe and board member of TNT Ltd, a TNT statement said.
No details were given of which other managers would leave the company or when the changes will go into effect.
Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) expects to complete its acquisition of TNT shares by the end of January.
Blochmann would be replaced by Vinzenz Wagner, currently chairman of German express company NET Express in Mannheim, the statement said.
Wagner worked for TNT until 1987 and thus already knew the company, it added.
Under Blockmann's management, TNT in Germany had developed into one of the most units within the company's international operations, it added.
The other management positions would be filled internally, the TNT statement said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
